content: We (researchers at the University of Pennsylvania) are looking for participants for an observational study about how users use proof assistants. The format is for participants to do the work they would normally do, and we will observe and ask questions. Anyone who is currently working on a proof development in Lean is welcome to participate. By default, the session will last 1.5 hours over Zoom, and we will pay $45. Shorter sessions are also possible. If interested, please fill out this form for Lean. Please also feel free to contact Jessica Shi at jwshi@seas.upenn.edu with questions. Thank you!
